items.raw_excerpt: We study outlier tokens in Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for image generation. Prior work has shown that Vision Transformers (ViTs) can produce a small number of high-norm tokens that attract disproportionate attention while carrying limited local information, but their role in generative models remains underexplored. Recently, IDC released its "IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Foundation Model Software 2026 Vendor Assessment" report. A total of 11 vendors worldwide were listed, and Alibaba Cloud was selected into the "Leaders" quadrant based on its Qwen model family and Qwen AI platform. It was the only Chinese vendor in this quadrant, alongside Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Amazon in the top tier.

IDC noted that 2026 has entered an era of multi-model, multi-agent, multimodal, and autonomous execution. Unlike single-dimension model benchmarks, this assessment examined the comprehensive competitiveness of "model capability plus service capability."

At the model layer, IDC pointed out that the Qwen large model family adopts a unified MoE architecture and pretraining paradigm, offering a full range of sizes from lightweight to Max scale, with support for reasoning, coding, and multilingual capabilities. It has launched dozens of self-developed models in text generation, reasoning, multimodal understanding, multimodal generation, and professional task domains.

At the model service layer, IDC stated that Alibaba Cloud provides a rich array of large language models, multimodal models, and scenario-optimized models, accompanied by a complete toolchain for data processing, fine-tuning, evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and application building and deployment.

Alibaba Cloud, gracias a la familia de modelos Qwen y a la plataforma de IA Qwen, ha sido seleccionada en el cuadrante de «Líderes (Leaders)», siendo la única empresa china en entrar en este cuadrante, junto a Google, Anthropic, OpenAI y Amazon en el primer escalón. items.title: Introducing Web Search on Amazon Bedrock for foundation model grounding
items.raw_excerpt: Today, we are introducing the general availability of Web Search on Amazon Bedrock. It is a server-side built-in tool that grounds model responses in current web knowledge.
